evidence: Every standard module (L0-L8) requires: SKILL.md (prompt file with YAML frontmatter having name: and description: >=20 chars; ## What this skill does and ## When to use headings; output contract section; body >=200 chars). skill-rules.json (required fields: module, layer, tier, activators, authority with owns+reads lists, verification_mode, receipt_required as boolean). rules/cold-start.md (cold-start procedure). tests/acceptance.md (acceptance criteria, required before any execution receipt). Modules tagged security/enforcement/receipt/gate must also contain word 'adversarial' in SKILL.md (warning, not gate fail).
